posts.name: Chaosmancer
posts.cooked:
padcurtin:

But she's well known as a child prodigy with a doctorate in mechanical engineering!!!  No one would buy her as a vapid party girl,  she goes to social events to promote her family's brand. Her cover Isn't rich idiot with no day job her cover is rich genius with a super busy day job. The wraith is a classic triple shifter like superman.

 

Jumping back in here, I think I agree with the "work hard, play hard" persona, but I think it goes deeper than that. Because, I've been to campuses, there are a lot of smart people qho act really, really dumb, and sometimes it is hard to remember.

 

 

So, how many layers does Maia out forth (and yes this is all calculated and difficult, but I'm talking perception)?

 

For one group, she's a socialite, living off her wealth and competing in all the petty games they compete in. This is Maia from the Ermine backstory. The proper rich girl. Most of these people probably forget she has a degree, or they figure that now that she has the degree she's taking the easy road and living off her money.

 

For the group that is smarter or has better memories, she's the work hard, play hard type. She goes in, puts in her 10 hour work day, she's viciously smart, but when it comes time to go clubbing or hang out at a social gathering she turns off the intensity and relaxes. She doesn't really care about the glamour scene, but its a fun distraction from the grind of her normal life, and after all how many boardroom sharks don't do the same?

 

 

I'd say there are about 4 or 5 five people in the world of the card game who realize that Maia Montgomery never turns off the intensity, but they usually don't call her by her first name.
